mechanism_and_next_test.inference: QB disturbance includes persistent transfer from QB through upper NAND NM total D/S ports into the real MID capacitor, opposed by PM pull-up replenishment. It persists after RB90 and is not explained by edge-only gate feedthrough.
mechanism_and_next_test.limitations: Total currents only; no saved region/Vth/channel component. Do not identify triode operation, amplifier overdrive recovery or pure Cgd. Lower off-intended NM transient drain current also includes displacement.
mechanism_and_next_test.propose_only: Change only XCLOCK.X003.CMID native MOM multi2->1 at identical device geometry, all MOS/drivers/loads/PWL/timing unchanged; compare MID charge, QB minimum/recovery, RB return, input burden and all physical stress. No next gate/library sweep or package generated.
mechanism_and_next_test.reason: Directly perturbs the observed downstream charge reservoir rather than mechanically replacing more logic. Less charge may trade against larger edge overshoot; no repair is presumed.
